adaptation: Packages the selected Modern layout, workspace, sidebar, conversation, chat, model-selector and Tool UI owners, presentation primitives/styles, public-contract adapters and language data. The composition disables only the replaced official UI entries, and composes the Desktop onboarding progress as skipped because its final write targets the disabled Chat namespace. Chat includes its data/view/flow/node/factory/settings closure; Tool includes generic/denied fallback, atomic views, todo-history and standard image child slots. The model selector uses a minimal attributed client catalog/directory/resolver checked against the published rc.4 browser artifact, with standard model-label contributions; Host model catalog and selection execution remain official. Ordinary question presentations reuse the official face and the same question store; plan-review and the Agent presets settings section remain official, the latter with patched typography in official-controls.css. Quotes and browser original-byte image transfers use public conversation/slot contracts. Plugin README utilities and selected Host compatibility entries are explicitly attributed below. Original Host session, command, remote, model catalog/selection, locale, theme, attachment-upload, plugin inventory/installer and question/preset business services remain official. No official package files, module tables or prototypes are modified. Retired per-session web controls and an unavailable Electron native file-drag bridge are not restored.

files.adaptation: Durable image reads go through src/host-contract.ts: 0.2.1 Sessions take the attachment id, 0.2.2 Sessions take the complete ImageAttachmentRef; the shape follows the release the Host publishes in its boot graph.
Publishes the row slack (positive or negative) as --dsh-composer-model-slack for the model trigger cap.
Phone widths narrow the control-row column gap to 6px.
Phone-width composer rows (container ≤480px) keep only the bulb for the effort and drop the chevron; the trigger cap adds the row slack that control-row-layout.ts publishes.

Re-copied from official 0.2.2-rc.1 packages/client/ui-primitives/src/markdown/file-link.ts (line/column suffixes and ranges; an invalid locator still opens the file) plus a one-line origin comment; keeps the rc.4 refusal of UNC and protocol-relative paths, which the official copy now accepts, so a click cannot make a Windows Host reach a network share. The bundled parser serves every supported Host.

Visible code requests share a dedicated Worker through the official asynchronous module transport. Grammar readiness, explicit failure/retry and owner lifetime stay on the main thread; the existing tokenizer, aliases and budgets are extracted below.
Folds the official 0.2.2-rc.1 windows-path-destinations.ts extension into this file (Windows-path link destinations keep every backslash) instead of adding a vendored copy.
reasoningFragments steps back from a high surrogate only when the cut stays above zero, so a one-character limit cannot loop on empty fragments.

Public chat registrations retain session/workspace ownership. Workspace file navigation resolves the final absolute target and passes it through sessionFileAddress(sessionId, absolutePath), preserving Session scope and the intended file when the default better-sidebar consumer resolves relative paths from a parent Git repository root.
Phone-width conversations show only the key reading (speed, cache hit) and tighten pill padding.
The lead segment of a two-part reading carries its own class so phone widths can show the key reading alone.
formatCacheHitPercent treats more cached than prompt tokens as a full hit; the gap search below it loops forever on a negative gap.

files.description: Moved the existing eight-language shared base here; Tool and Conversation retain their namespace adapters without duplicate key/value copies.

files.adaptation: Extracted CSS-variable theme and JavaScript-regex engine; grammar initialization and warmups now execute in the dedicated Worker.
Extracted language imports and original Go grammar correction; all 60 grammars remain available on demand.
Extracted language aliases, long-line limit, synchronous-work budget and streaming quotas shared by main thread and Worker.
Extracted tokenization, line HTML and incremental grammar-state session. The Worker sends committed prefixes in bounded batches and retains offsets across discarded responses.

authored.description: Original private cooperation face over the selected layout owner geometry store.
Mounts the product icon sprite the patched ui-theme shipped with the shell; the official rc.4 shell has no symbols.
Typed public slot registration shared by the verified rc.2, rc.3 and rc.4 contracts; optional Modern process fields are adapted at the rendering boundary.
Registers the Modern Markdown file preview body and plan preview body that shadow the official keyed entries (priority -100) so both previews fold code fences.

State and revision-fenced writes of the reasoning-declaration block on pi-ai provider cards: stored models list from the shared settings form, installed-catalog ids from the adapter, levels from the namespace schema.
Original per-row local draft editor with Save/Cancel, inherited models, hidden-field preservation, and first-edit revision fencing; uses the separately attributed ModelReasoningEfforts view.
Registration of the reasoning-declaration block: dictionaries, controller, keyed provider-card entry.
Original plugin composition, public owner selection and presentation/service registration.
Original Desktop onboarding recovery: re-inherits progress saved over the bundle patch's skipped onboarding composition through the public settings form.
Original reversible code-disclosure DOM adapter for the observed dsh-better-sidebar 0.28.0 public preview markup. No community controller, viewer, editor or library code is copied.
Original Host manifest/configuration, migration settings and plugin entry wiring.
Original reversible exact-class rc.4 style/DOM adapter. It observes official controlled switch state through the attributed Feel solver without replacing official handlers or services.
Original public plugin detail-section registration and discovery-presentation adapter over the official inventory, installer, locale and controller faces.
Original authenticated document/image request, cancellation and retry wrapper over the attributed DetailDocument presenter.

Original public presentation adapter for ordinary questions, sharing the official controller face and question draft-store handle. Plan-review and the Agent presets settings section stay official; added disclosure labels are plugin-owned eight-language copy.
Original public SlotRegistry subscription helper that withdraws and rebinds a presentation when its source entry changes generation.
Original activation wrapper selecting the attributed complete Tool UI owner.
Original bridge from this activation's valid image-transfer token into the existing composer file intake and validation.
Original type-only aliases over the published official DiscoverFace and DiscoverState; no market controller or business store is copied.
Type-only package contract and official module augmentations for third-party text interaction consumers; emitted as the ./quotes declaration export.
Arrow, Home and End navigation over the visible tabs of the official plugin tab ledger, whose duplicated Discover entry stays hidden.
Resolves plan document file links and images against the plan's own Session or subagent working directory, mirroring the official plan address grammar.
Removes unambiguous strong delimiters from bounded live status text with the plugin's Markdown parser.
Closes an open floating surface when an official or Modern modal takes the foreground, read from the shared official modal stack.
Original code-fence presenter that renders openui-lang blocks with @openuidev/react-lang inside answers, routes @ToAssistant through the Session input actions, and keeps unparsable source readable.
Original styles for the OpenUI block frame, placeholder and preserved-source card.
Original pure helpers for openui-lang fences: which bodies render, whether a reply holds a complete fence, the parse size bound, and the text a @ToAssistant click sends.

Original optional TypeSafe Jev presentation advice tool: registered only in main agents' own tool scopes while the presentation prompt, jev.enabled and a resolvable key allow it; on a model call it sends the user messages of the turn being processed plus the model's structure summary (at most 600 characters) as one System One choice per turn, and returns an ordinary, ignorable tool result; a missing key, errors and cancellation return "no suggestion" and never fail a turn.

Original Tool-row copy for jev_presentation_advice in the eight interface languages: its title and the outcome label read from the tool's result metadata (choice or status); the recorded confidence is deliberately not shown.
Original state for the Jev settings row: the jev.enabled switch through the Modern UI config form and the TypeSafe key through the official credentials Remote, which never returns the value.
Original Settings → General row for the optional Jev presentation advice tool: what it does, a write-only key field built from the official SettingsSecretField, and the switch once a key exists.
Original styles for the Jev settings row, matching the Modern preference rows.

Original per-block step budget for openui-lang blocks: a counted view of the component library, the counters for the build-time patched evaluator and parser of @openuidev/lang-core (loops, built lists, objects and text, what each loop pass produces, component props, parsed nodes) and the parse limit, which stop an over-budget parse, evaluation or render in the @openuidev/react-lang runtime.
Host contract differences one build bridges across releases, chosen from the published Host release: the Session image read argument (attachment id before 0.2.2, complete reference from 0.2.2).
Original scalar lifecycle selectors preserving the existing main/header/view phase semantics.
Original stable tab/panel IDs shared by the conversation header and view shell.
Loads the existing OpenUI renderer on demand, preserving source text and explicit retry after a confirmed script transport failure.
Identifies the official module loader script-request error at the optional-renderer boundary.
Loads the existing KaTeX renderer on demand, preserving TeX and explicit retry after a confirmed script transport failure.
Optional entry that reuses the existing bounded KaTeX renderer and its stylesheet.
Pending formula source and retry-action layout for narrow viewports.
Typed messages for grammar registration, cancellable code views, incremental line progress and worker results.
Dedicated Worker entry executing the attributed tokenizer with per-view cancellation and incremental result delivery.

adapters.description: Bridge the public chat owner workspace and navigation capabilities into Modern Markdown; resolve local image and file paths with the official workspace-path helper.
Activation-owned browser image transfer service and public gallery contributions; official attachment upload and conversation.images.content ownership remain unchanged.

Adapted model seat and /model registration using the attributed local client catalog/directory/resolver and the standard conversation.input.model.label child slot. Official Host catalog, session, remote and selection execution services remain external.

Selected patched style deltas mapped to exact published rc.4 Web/client classes. The seven Web modules that 0.2.2-rc.1 rebuilt under new hashes (Button, HoverCard, DisclosureRow, ConfigField, SegmentedTabs, MenuSurface, Modal) also list their published 0.2.2-rc.1 class names as alternatives; HoverCard and Modal, which 0.2.2-rc.2 rebuilt again, and the account notice card, which 0.2.2-rc.2 moved from ui-settings-account to ui-account-notifications, list that release's names as a third. The deltas themselves are unchanged, except that the HoverCard delta also points the hover-card theme tokens 0.2.2-rc.2 introduced at the same surface and labels. The retired ConfigField delta applies only to the current SettingsValueField gap; no retired component or business owner is restored.
Eight-language detail-read failure vocabulary and Markdown disclosure labels with original modern-plugin-documents namespace wiring.
Quote admission and sent-text registration over Modern's conversation owner, with a public standard text-interaction contract and the existing input quote action.
Complete Tool UI owner adapted to rc.4 public payloads, fallback/denial presentation, todo-history and standard tool.call.images. Host execution, approvals, MCP and sessions remain official.
Browser-only original-byte transfer and image-only filename adaptation. The official rc.4 Host exposes no Electron native file-drag bridge; no native OS drag capability is claimed.
Eight-language reasoning-level editor vocabulary plus original provider-card save/cancel/refusal copy under modern-reasoning.
Original flat provider-card shell plus adapted per-level selector, API-wire input, help and deletion styles from the patched Models editor.

Client-only shared catalog state. Existing TypeScript is checked against the published rc.4 browser artifact region lib/types/client/catalog.js (ModelCatalogDirectory, captured lines 710-801). Official Host catalog/Session Remote execution remains external. Also exports refreshOnModelsUpdated: 0.2.2 Hosts emit llm/models-updated when an adapter catalog changes; older Hosts never emit it.

Client-only per-session shared model-selection directory, checked against the published rc.4 browser artifact region lib/types/client/directory.js (ModelDirectory, captured lines 802-984). The type-only projection import follows rc.4 api-session-controller/types. No Host or Session implementation is copied.

Minimal TypeScript adaptation of the published rc.4 browser artifact region lib/types/client/service.js (ModelDirectoryResolver, captured lines 985-1041): directoryFor and catalog/event lifecycle only. Legacy-only catalogStore/loadCatalog APIs and duplicate public Context declarations are omitted. No runtime import from the disabled official browser entry remains. Also refreshes on llm/models-updated (0.2.2 Hosts; older Hosts never emit it).

translations.description: Original code/text disclosure labels, registered separately from the official question and preset dictionaries.

host.purpose: Explicit compatibility plugins retain blank-translation/cache repair, MCP no-redirect behavior, the attributed HTTP provider with a plugin-owned Undici transport, authenticated read-only plugin README utilities and boot-page style deltas. Normal npm dependencies (including Undici 8.12.2) apply only to these plugin entries; they do not replace or certify the entire official dependency tree, and no Zod floor is claimed.
